vulnerability.name: USN-4905-2
vulnerability.description: USN-4905-1 fixed a vulnerability in X.Org. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 14.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   Jan-Niklas Sohn discovered that the X.Org X Server incorrectly handled  certain lengths of XInput extension ChangeFeedbackControl requests. An  attacker could use this issue to cause the server to crash, resulting in a  denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code.

statements.status_notes: X.Org X Server could be made to crash or run programs if it received specially crafted input. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
